'''Ginli Kahraka''' was an individual sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] as part of a survey team to [[Mission to the Emperor's Fortress (Third Galactic War)|investigate]] the wreckage of [[Darth Malgus]]'s [[Emperor's Fortress|space station]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]<ref name="Dark Heart of the Fortress" /> around [[3623 BBY]].<ref name="Death" /> Kahraka was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the mission by an exploding [[Power coupler|power coupler]]. Later, the [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Lana Beniko]] retrieved a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] that belonged to Kahraka. Beniko believed that Kahraka was a personal friend of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]].<ref name="Dark Heart of the Fortress" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ginli Kahraka first appeared in the ''Galactic Threads'' storyline released in Game Update 7.8: ''Pursuit of Ruin'', released on [[December 9]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251209-2|text=Game Update 7.8 "Pursuit of Ruin" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref> Ginli Kahraka's name is misspelled in the datapad as "Ginli Kharaka's Datapad." Additionally, Lana Beniko will mention that Kahraka was a personal friend of Jedi Master Gnost-Dural if the player is aligned with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. If the player is aligned with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Kahraka is instead identified as a member of the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]].<ref name="Dark Heart of the Fortress" />
